title: HR Administrator
description:
Are you an experienced HR Administrator looking for your next opportunity within a busy, growing business?

SF Partners is working with a well-established and growing organisation in Lichfield to recruit an experienced HR Administrator on a 12-month fixed-term contract. You'll join an established HR team and play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day HR operations. We're looking for someone who is confident in their HR administration experience, can quickly pick up processes and systems, and is comfortable managing a varied workload with minimal supervision.

Location: Lichfield
Salary: £32,000-£35,000
12 month FTC - Hybrid working - 3 days office 2 days home

Key Responsibilities
- Manage HR administration across the employee lifecycle, including contracts, offer letters, employee changes and leaver documentation.
- Maintain accurate employee records and update the HR system, ensuring compliance with GDPR requirements.
- Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, including inductions and exit documentation.
- Support payroll administration by providing accurate employee information and processing changes.
- Assist with employee benefits administration, including enrolments and amendments.
- Act as a first point of contact for HR queries, providing guidance on policies and procedures.
- Provide administrative support with employee relations matters, including disciplinaries and grievances.
- Produce HR reports covering headcount, absence and employee turnover.
- Support HR projects, employee engagement activities and training initiatives.
- Ensure HR processes and documentation are accurate, organised and compliant.

About You

We're particularly interested in speaking with candidates who have:
- Strong, proven HR administration experience within a busy HR environment.
- Experience managing the full employee lifecycle.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confidence using HR systems and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.
- Strong communication skills and a professional, approachable manner.
- A proactive attitude, with the confidence to take ownership of their workload.
- Experience supporting payroll, benefits administration and employee relations processes would be advantageous.

This opportunity would suit an established HR Administrator or HR Coordinator who enjoys being hands-on, thrives in a busy environment and can quickly become a valued member of the team.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £32,000-£35,000.
- Hybrid working - 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.
- 12-month fixed-term contract with potential for a permanent opportunity.
- Opportunity to join a growing organisation with approximately 1,100 employees.
- Established and supportive HR team.
- A varied role offering exposure to the full employee lifecycle.

title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Location: Rugeley (WS15)

Hours: 25-30 hours per week (flexible)

Pay: Up to 14.30 per hour

Working arrangements: Hybrid

Want to grow your career while maintaining work-life balance?

We're working with a well-established specialist contractor delivering sustainable infrastructure solutions across Britain looking for an experienced HR Administrator to join the team.

You'll provide day-to-day HR support across the business, helping with everything from recruitment and onboarding through to employee records, payroll support and training.

What you'll be doing
- Supporting recruitment, onboarding and pre-employment checks.
- Preparing job adverts, offer letters and employment contracts.
- Maintaining accurate and confidential employee records.
- Updating HR systems, including BrightHR and TimeKeeper.
- Managing training records and arranging employee training.
- Supporting payroll with timesheets, absences and contractual changes.
- Acting as a first point of contact for general HR queries.
- Supporting employees with policies, holiday entitlement and HR procedures.
- Ensuring HR records are accurate and GDPR compliant.
- Providing general HR administration support to the wider business.

What we're looking for
- PreviousHR administration experience is essential.
- CIPD Level 3/4 qualified or currently working towards a qualification.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.
- Experience using HR systems or databases.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisation.
- Confident communication skills.
- A professional and discreet approach when handling confidential information.
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths.

What's on offer?
- Up to 14.30 for 25 to 30 hours
- 25-30 hours per week, ideally across 5 days.
- Flexible hours (potentially ideal for school hours).
- 1 day per week working from home.
- CIPD training support available, with the company able to cover training costs subject to its training policy.
- Opportunity to develop your HR career within a growing business.
- Supportive team environment.
- Pension scheme with auto-enrolment.

If you're an experienced HR Administrator looking for a flexible role where you can continue developing your HR career, apply today!

title: L&D Coordinator
description:
SF Partners are recruiting for a Learning & Development Coordinator to help organise employee training and professional development.
Working closely with the L&D Manager, you'll keep learning activities on track, maintain accurate records and act as a helpful point of contact for employees and external training providers.

£30,000-£35,000 depending on experience
Full time - Hybrid working available

Your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating training bookings, assessments and enrolments.
- Tracking learning progress, deadlines and costs.
- Maintaining accurate records and producing reports.
- Liaising with training providers to resolve queries and support learners.
- Coordinating mandatory training across the business.
- Updating learning materials and improving administrative processes.

About you
You'll have at least two years' experience in a similar role, with strong organisational skills and a thorough approach to administration. You'll be comfortable managing competing deadlines, working across different systems and building relationships with colleagues and external providers.
Experience within a busy HR or L&D team is relevant. Familiarity with learning management systems and CIPD Level 3 would be useful but are not essential.
A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel when required are essential.

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Recruitment Administrator Office-based in Stoke on Trent Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 2:30pm (flexible) 15 per hour Structured hours with strong work-life balance in a busy recruitment environment

Meridian Business Support are looking to appoint a Recruitment Administrator to support day-to-day operations within a well established branch. This position plays a key part in ensuring payroll accuracy and smooth onboarding for a large candidate workforce.

As a Recruitment Administrator, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate records and delivering timely payroll processing within a fast-moving environment:
- Process weekly payroll, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
- Collate, check and verify timesheets with a high level of accuracy
- Calculate holiday pay, overtime, bonuses and adjustments using Excel and internal systems
- Maintain and update candidate records within the CRM system
- Enter new starters and ensure all personal and assignment data is recorded correctly
- Issue assignment details, contracts and relevant onboarding documentation to candidates
- Answer the phone, and responding to queries from both candidates and clients

To be successful in this Recruitment Administrator role, you will demonstrate:
- Excellent communication skills including via the phone and email
- Strong Excel skills, including confidence with calculations and data management
- Previous experience using CRM systems or recruitment databases
- Excellent attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and compliance
- Ability to manage high-volume administrative tasks and meet strict deadlines
- Experience within payroll, recruitment administration or a similar coordination role is desirable

Benefits and working environment
- 15 per hour
- Consistent weekday hours with no weekend work
- Office-based role offering structure and routine
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Possible Opportunity to develop within a growing recruitment business

If you are a detail-focused administrator looking for a busy and structured position where your organisational and Excel skills will be valued, this Recruitment Administrator position offers a stable and rewarding next step.

Meridian Business Support is a recruitment specialist acting on behalf of our client as an Employment Agency for this vacancy.

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Used to speaking to customers all day? Comfortable making back-to-back calls? Your skills could be a great match for Recruitment - take the step with Adecco.

We're looking for Recruiters / Resourcers to join our busy high-volume recruitment team. Previous recruitment experience isn't essential. We're looking for people with strong telephone and customer service skills who can work at pace, stay organised and deliver a great candidate experience.

The Details:
- 13.50 per hour
- Full time Mon-Fri 37 hours
- Hybrid - based in our Keele office 2 days per week, work from home 3 days per week
- Temporary contract for 3 months

At Adecco, recruitment is about people, not sales targets. You'll play a key role in helping candidates find meaningful careers while supporting some of the UK's leading employers with exceptional talent. Working in a collaborative and supportive environment, you'll have access to industry-leading tools, ongoing training and the backing of a globally recognised recruitment brand. If you enjoy building relationships, making a positive impact, and delivering a great candidate experience, this opportunity could be the perfect fit.

You'll be:
- Making high volumes of candidate calls
- Screening candidates for vacancies
- Managing candidates through the recruitment process
- Booking interviews and preparing shortlists
- Supporting pre-employment checks
- Updating candidate records and recruitment systems
- Working towards recruitment and service targets

We're looking for:
- Experience in a customer contact, call centre, recruitment or other phone-based environment is desirable
- Experience working with high volumes of telephone calls
- Confident and professional communication
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- The ability to work at pace and manage competing priorities
- Able to adapt to changing priorities and maintain a consistent service in a busy environment
- Good IT skills

Benefits:
- Work from home 3 days per week
- First class support and training
- Weekly Pay
- Online payslips
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Access to Able Futures
- Eyecare vouchers
- Access to Boost benefits such as discounted shopping vouchers, services, attraction tickets and more
- Smart Spending App
- Workplace Pension scheme

If you're confident communicating with people over the phone, enjoy a fast-paced environment and want to turn your customer service skills into a career in recruitment, apply today.

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

title: Service Coordinator
company: Adullam Homes Housing Association - Agency - Permanent
description:
Could you be our missing piece?

Adullam has opportunities available to join our national award-winning support team in Stoke.

About the role Service Coordinator
- The main purpose of this role is to provide support to people with multiple and complex needs as part of a service for those who have lost their home or been rough sleeping.
- You will help a service user to develop the skills needed to move on into independent living/permanent housing via a person-centred support package that is tailor made to suit the needs of everyone accessing the service.
- The role works on a rota to contribute to the staffing of a 24-hours-a-day service.
- The role is full time of 37.5 hours per week. The shift pattern is 7.5 hours a day between the hours of 9am and 10pm weekdays, with some weekend delivering activities and support sessions.
- You will be expected to work within the organisation's charitable aims and objectives and contribute to the maintenance and development of the Association's values, culture, and ethos.

About you

We are looking for a Service Coordinator with:
- Experience of managing a caseload of service users;
- An awareness of issues relating to vulnerable individuals and those that have faced multiple disadvantages;
- Experience in helping others understand their goals and helping them to achieve an outcome;
- Skills in recording and reporting case notes via an online Customer Relationship Management system;
- Experience of working within safeguarding policies and procedures and of identifying, monitoring, and reporting safeguarding concerns;
- A flexible, resilient, thoughtful, therapeutic approach to working with people;
- Practical skills to support service users in activities of daily living required for independence;
- An ability to motivate and empower service users to have greater control and choice over their life and opportunities;
- An ability to demonstrate our values and behaviours and work within our Christian ethos.

Although lived experience is not essential, it is welcomed as part of our workforce. Adullam understands that lived experienced means people have valuable, direct knowledge of how it feels to be in receipt of support services, and what needs to change for the better.

Our offer to you

We are a friendly, people-focused organisation making sure to prioritise and take care of the overall wellbeing of our staff, whilst helping them strive for excellence and reach their full potential. There is training available to help you progress in your chosen career and friendly but focused management that will help oversee your growth.

This role is salaried at £26,890.50 pro-rota.

In addition to your salary, we also have a list of generous benefits and initiatives that will help support you and your family, both in and outside the workplace.
- 25 days annual leave increasing to 30 days with service, plus Bank Holidays
- Two extra days leave for no unplanned absences each calendar year.
- Pension Plan
- Death in Service benefit
- Multidimensional wellbeing programmes and family friendly policies for staff
- Access to Medicash
- Access to Blue Light Card
- Refer a friend policy

About us
- Adullam Homes Housing Association Ltd is a Community Benefit Society, an Association created to support vulnerable individuals and households.
- Adullam provides quality accommodation and support as an organisation motivated and informed by our Christian ethos.
- We provide quality housing, deliver tailored support plans, training, education, and employment opportunities to help people achieve stable lives and realise their full potential.

We are passionate about actively encouraging applicants from all cultures, backgrounds, and identities. We are committed to treating our teams fairly and with respect, irrespective of their background, disability, or any other protected characteristic and this starts with our recruitment process.

Adullam Homes Housing Association Ltd. is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and adults accessing our services. We expect all staff, volunteers, and workers to share this commitment. As part of our commitment to safer recruitment, the successful candidate will be subject to an Enhanced with Barred List Adult Only DBS check, scrutiny of employment history, satisfactory pre-employment checks and robust references checks.

Please note applicants must be authorised to work in the UK as we are unable to provide Visa sponsorships.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early and/or make an appointment before the advertised closing date if a suitable candidate is identified.

Adullam Homes Housing Association was created in 1972 to support vulnerable individuals and households. From the simple beginning of a single property in Birmingham, Adullam has expanded into new geographical locations and developed new services.

Over the years it has introduced and run innovative projects to offer tenants, residents and service users opportunities for housing, support, education and training.

title: Talent Acquisition Advisor (12 Month FTC)
description:
12 Month Fixed Term Contract - Maternity Cover

Hours: 32 Hours Per Week Across 4 days (Flexible on none working day)

Salary: Up to 24,000

Grade: 4.3

Location: Based in Cannock (WS11 8 JP) with a hybrid working arrangement
When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. It's why we're looking for someone who's just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life. We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture.
What we can offer you:
- Access to our company pension scheme
- On-site Gym
- Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers
- Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to
- 24 hour access to a virtual GP, 365 days a year, for you and family members in your household
- One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community
- Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full potential

What you'll be doing:
- Manage the end-to-end recruitment process from job posting to offer, collaborating closely with hiring managers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver quality candidates
- Screen applications and create shortlists of qualified candidates, while maintaining excellent candidate communications throughout to ensure a positive recruitment experience
- Utilise and maintain the applicant tracking system (Workday) to progress recruitment activity and track key hiring metrics including time to hire, cost per hire and source of hire
- Build and maintain talent pools for future requirements, proactively headhunting candidates through social platforms for hard-to-fill positions
- Provide consultative advice to hiring managers on best practice interviewing techniques and assessment methods to support effective decision-making
- Host and participate in job fairs and support continuous improvement projects within the Talent Acquisition team to enhance recruitment processes and outcomes

What we're looking for:
- Previous recruitment experience in either agency or in-house environments, with preference for candidates who have recruited for operational, engineering or industrial roles
- Demonstrated experience in high-volume recruitment environments with the ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously while maintaining quality standards
- Proven ability to develop and maintain effective stakeholder relationships with hiring managers and business partners
- Proficiency in candidate sourcing and headhunting techniques across social platforms including LinkedIn, Indeed and CV Library.
- Experience working with applicant tracking systems, with Workday knowledge being advantageous
- Excellent communication, interpersonal and collaborative working skills with the ability to work effectively within a team environment

What's next?

Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.

We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.

We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long-term condition who opt-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles.

We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
